title: 第三章 课堂上的前女友第四章 给你们讲个故事
content_zh:
“陆原，你在哪呢，赶紧来上课了，这节课是管理学啊，你可别迟到了！”
张辉发来了一条信息。
管理学老师叫郑谷，一个很尖酸刻薄的老师，最不喜欢学生迟到，据说迟到三次，直接挂科。
陆原不敢怠慢，提着塑胶袋一路狂奔，连宿舍都来不及回去了，直接来到了教学楼。
“报告。”
紧赶慢赶，还是迟到了。
陆原站在门口，感觉全班人的眼睛都盯着自己。
足足有三十秒钟，郑谷看都没有看陆原，还在那里滔滔不绝的讲课。
似乎完全无视了陆原，那气氛，要多尴尬，有多尴尬。
“捡垃圾都捡的忘记了时间了？迟到了你知道不？你到底是学生还是流浪汉？”
终于，郑谷扶了扶眼镜，一连串的炮火。
很明显，这些问题，并不需要回答，这，只是在侮辱。
班里大部分学生，都哄堂大笑起来。
没错，谁都能看到陆原手里提着那个很大的塑胶袋，的确很显眼，毕竟里面装了一百万呢。
而且，陆原穿的破旧，再加上这一个垃圾袋一样的，确实很像拾荒的。
“来，把塑料袋打开，让大伙儿看看你都捡了什么宝贝。”
郑谷又调侃道。
哄！
班级里又是一阵笑声。
“不用了。”

陆原淡淡的说道。
郑谷虽然是老师，但是为人并不咋地，很看不起那些贫穷的学生，但是对于家境不错有地位的学生，郑谷一向都和颜悦色的。
陆原不喜欢这种两面的人。
“哼，带着你的宝贝，回到你位置上去！记住了，再迟到两次，我的课你就别想拿学分了！真是越穷越没出息！”
看陆原这样，郑谷也觉得没意思了，喝道。
陆原乖乖的遵从。
从门口到位置上。
不少同学都盯着他手里的塑胶袋看，有的相互之间还交头接耳，然后发出一种嘻嘻的笑声，估计都是在说他捡垃圾的事情。
回到位置，陆原并没有听课。
趴在桌子上睡觉，今天这一番折腾，实在有点累。
这就是大学的好处，上课的时候，只要你不讲话不捣蛋不影响其他同学，你想干嘛都没人管你。
正睡着，陆原就感觉到胳膊被人拍了一下。
一看，竟然是李梦瑶。
“这些，都是你的？”
李梦瑶指着那个塑料袋，此时，已经被打开了，里面一叠一叠的人民币，全部露出来了。
此时，李梦瑶脸上没有分手时候那种冰冷和轻蔑了，露出的是一种说不尽的媚意。
陆原心里却泛起一阵恶心，也没答话，提起塑料袋就走。
“亲爱的，亲爱的！”
content_en:
"Lu Yuan, where are you? Come to class quickly. This class is management. Don't be late!"
Zhang Hui sent a message.
The management teacher is Zheng Gu, a very mean teacher who dislikes students being late. It is said that if he is late three times, he will fail the class.
Lu Yuan didn't dare to neglect, and ran all the way with the plastic bag. He didn't even have time to go back to the dormitory, and went straight to the teaching building.
"Report."
Hurry up and hurry up, you're still late.
Lu Yuan stood at the door, feeling that everyone in the class was staring at him.
For thirty seconds, Zheng Gu didn't even look at Lu Yuan and was still lecturing.
It seemed that Lu Yuan was completely ignored. The atmosphere was so awkward and awkward.
"You've forgotten the time while picking up trash? Do you know you're late? Are you a student or a homeless person?"
Finally, Zheng Gu adjusted his glasses and unleashed a series of gunfire.
Obviously, these questions do not need to be answered. This is just insulting.
Most of the students in the class burst into laughter.
Yes, everyone can see that Lu Yuan is holding the big plastic bag in his hand. It is indeed very conspicuous. After all, there is one million in it.
Moreover, Lu Yuan's clothes were shabby and looked like a garbage bag, so he really looked like a scavenger.
"Here, open the plastic bag and let everyone see what treasures you have picked up."
Zheng Gu teased again.
coax!
There was another burst of laughter in the class.
"No need."
Lu Yuan said calmly.
Although Zheng Gu is a teacher, he is not a very good person and looks down on those poor students. However, Zheng Gu has always been kind to students who come from well-off families and have good status.
Lu Yuan doesn't like such two-faced people.
"Hmph, take your baby and go back to your seat! Remember, if you are late twice more, you will not get any credit for my class! The poorer you are, the less promising you are!"
Seeing Lu Yuan like this, Zheng Gu felt bored and shouted.
Lu Yuan obeyed obediently.
From the door to the location.
Many classmates stared at the plastic bag in his hand, and some even whispered to each other, and then burst into laughter, probably talking about his garbage collection.
Returning to his position, Lu Yuan did not listen to the lecture.
I lay down on the table to sleep. I was really tired after all the hard work today.
This is the good thing about college. During class, as long as you don't talk, don't make trouble, and don't disturb other students, no one will care about what you want to do.
Just as he was falling asleep, Lu Yuan felt his arm being tapped.
At first glance, it turned out to be Li Mengyao.
"These are all yours?"
Li Mengyao pointed to the plastic bag. At this time, it had been opened, and the stacks of RMB inside were all exposed.
At this time, Li Mengyao's face was no longer as cold and contemptuous as when they broke up, but showed an indescribable charm.
Lu Yuan felt nauseated in his heart, and without answering, he picked up the plastic bag and left.
"Honey, darling!"
